summary: This study is testing different combination treatments for adults with recently diagnosed type 2 diabetes, a condition where the body has trouble managing blood sugar levels. The trial plans to enroll 256 participants to compare how well these medication combinations lower blood sugar over time. The sponsor for this research is The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio. The study is currently Recruiting under Phase 3.
